shots.seen: Bright storybook bedroom: purple-blue wall with polka dots, pink curtains, yellow moon, sky-blue blanket, orange wood; everything evenly lit. Detailed, but reads cosy and cheerful, not frightening.
shots.fix: Switch to the horror theme: cold desaturated palette, darkness mask with light only from the moon, the door strip and the red clock; add damp stains, cracks, peeling paper, cobweb, a bare dead bulb, a doll facing the wall; slight dutch tilt.

shots.seen: Warm door close-up with a red school bag, teal slippers and a purple rug; the foot shadows are there but the colours make it look like a toy shop.
shots.fix: Horror theme, remove the playful props, add claw scratches and a dried handprint on the door, grime on the wall, keep only the strip as light so the feet read as silhouettes in the only bright area.

shots.seen: Bright close-up of the kid with blush and sweat drop under a sky-blue blanket; expression is scared but the frame is so bright and saturated that it reads cute.
shots.fix: Horror theme (pale skin, no blush), light the face only from the door side with a cold moon rim from the left, crush everything else to near-black, add the dark gap under the bed edge in frame.
